title: Tenma Saki — Embracing Memories〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh, preparations complete!
Now if Tsukasa will just come home...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I'm home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa, do you remember what you promised to do today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
We're working through the list of things you want to do, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, which will it be today?
“Race into the sunset”...? No, perhaps “Put on a show with Tsukasa”?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Neither!
I mean, that second one isn't even on my list!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! I-Is that so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, but let's still do that sometime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... Today, we'll be doing this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm... Wooden blocks? And books, notebooks, writing utensils, shogi pieces...
What on earth are we going to use these for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Have a guess! We're gonna line these up all in a row, and then knock them down with a clickety clack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aha! So, a domino chain, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thaaat's right!
I watched a domino chain competition on TV back when I was in the hospital, and it made me want to try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, now that you mention it, you did have that on your list. Still, to think you'd use items from around the house in place of dominoes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Such creativity and drive!
As expected of my sister!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright!
We'll set up our dominoes all over the house, and make a successful chain!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm... This notebook is hard to stand up since it's so thin... Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Tsukasa!
I messed up and started the chain, so stop it over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
Leave it to me! Here it shall meet its—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Gaaah!
I stepped on a block! My foot, my fooooot!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Are you okay, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How can we get it to go down the stairs...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Shouldn't it work if we use objects that are taller than the steps?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Taller than the steps... Oh, like these fashion magazines!
No, they won't fall right, and they'll end up breaking the chain...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what if we used this ball?!
We can place some books a little bit apart and make a path for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a good idea!
Okay, let's put it to the test!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... Now we just hope that it makes it all the way to the finish line!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay... Here we go, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Three, two, one... Start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's the corner we were having trouble with... Yes! It got past!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And the stairs... Woohoo! It made it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, just a little more!
If it'll just continue until it rings the bell at the finish line...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did it, Saki!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... So this is how satisfying it feels to make a successful domino chain...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! I feel like I just finished a show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I kinda feel like I just finished a set at a live house too! Oh...! I've gotta get a picture to remember this feeling by!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Use the selfie camera, get the finish line in the shot... Tsukasa, you get in too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Over here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, perfect!
Okay, here goes! Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, if I'm doing it for your sake, I could do this in my sleep!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, how many things do you have left on your list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just over ten more, thanks to the help I've had from my friends and seniors at school!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! To think you've already accomplished that many of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, the day you complete your list is likely not far away...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was able to make so many fun memories because of your suggestion to make this list!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's not true, Saki.
I may have been the one to suggest making the list, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The reason you've been able to accomplish the things you wanted to do is because you overcame your illness and decided to try all kinds of things, wouldn't you say?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't be more proud...that I get to have a strong, determined sister like you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But, the reason I was able to do that was...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Because I always had my cheery, positive-thinking brother around.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah! I mustn't be standing around!
I have to prepare the party we'll have when you complete everything on your list!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Tsukasa, you're totally jumping the gun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... But, I'm looking forward to it!
